subject: Report file (record structure)
notes: kb/Work PB690 (w61d). A.1 item 159 (cite.py --check 13.4.5.4 'The report writer logical record structure of the file associated with file-name-1 is defined by the implementor' -> OK 4)). One print line per record, one byte per column in ISO/IEC 8859-1: MEASURED 'AéB' is written as 41 E9 42 (ORD 234 read back), never '?'; a line holding U+20AC is refused ('91' in the report file's connector — GENERATE sets no FILE STATUS item, §9.1.13.1) and leaves a blank line, the device line not moving on a refused write so the next line lands on its own LINE-COUNTER line (ReportWriter).
